question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Credible
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Unreliable)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Credible"** means something or someone that is believable, trustworthy, or reliable. (विश्वसनीय)

 
 
• **Example:** The newspaper article was based on credible sources.
 
 
 
• **"Unreliable"** refers to something or someone that cannot be trusted or depended upon. (अविश्वसनीय)
 
 
• **Example:** The witness gave an unreliable statement during the trial.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'credible' **is **'unreliable'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Unreliable)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fantastic** (काल्पनिक): Refers to something extraordinary, imaginary, or unrealistic.

 
 
• **Example:** The movie showcased fantastic creatures in a magical world.
 
 
 
• **Credulous** (भोलाभाला): Refers to someone who is too ready to believe things, often without evidence.
 
 
• **Example:** She was so credulous that she believed every word of the scammer.
 
 
 
• **Friendly** (मित्रवत): Refers to someone or something that is kind and pleasant.
 
 
• **Example:** The neighbours were very friendly and welcoming.
